description: Figure 5(b), titled “P6: Matching statistics,” presents a bar-chart style summary of matching counts for Persona 6 across five frequency tiers labeled P1 through P5, with a single series of five categories (so 5 bars total). Each bar is colored in a light salmon/pink tone and has a numeric value printed at its top: P1 is approximately 1.00, P2 about 0.87, P3 about 0.76, P4 about 0.60, and P5 about 0.56. The bars appear arranged from left to right in decreasing height, and there is no legend visible within this subfigure; the values are shown directly as labels on the bars.
